turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I found out from the gradebook that you gave my son a zero, and no one called me first. I'd like to know who decided that, and on what basis.
Fine, but you haven't answered me. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis? I have until 4:40.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
"Everyone knows it." Who is everyone, and where is it written down? My child never lies, and I'm writing down that you said that, Hale. I'll be in the principal's office when we're done here.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I've asked two questions and you've answered neither. Is there a document, or is it just what "everyone knows"? Withdraw the zero, Hale, or I'm going upstairs.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
You entered a zero without calling me, and your own procedure says you call first. That's the time being wasted. Show me what you have, or withdraw the mark.
